name: s124-protect-files-blocks-commit-a-tracked-env
setup_commands: git init -q . && git add .env src/app.ts && git -c user.name=kitbench -c user.email=kitbench@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m init && printf 'API_KEY=another-fake-key\n' > .env && printf 'export const x = 2;\n' > src/app.ts

tool_input.command: git add src/app.ts && git commit -m "chore: bump"

notes: git commit -a stages every modified tracked file, a tracked .env included, and passed (exit 0). Staging the other file by name stays allowed.
